capabilities: Convert \( \) and \[ \] math delimiters to $ and $$ blocks
Remove AI citation markers while keeping links and footnotes
Strip leftover copy-button text and language labels
Convert unicode bullets and 1) lists into markdown lists
Clean zero-width characters, non-breaking spaces and extra blank lines
extras: All processing is local with no network requests; every rule can be toggled in settings, and pasting is left untouched when nothing needs fixing. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Pasting AI chat output into Obsidian produces markdown Obsidian renders poorly, with broken math delimiters, stray citation markers and leftover copy-button text.
summary: Plugin that cleans markdown pasted from AI chatbots, fixing math delimiters, citation markers, copy-button text, lists and whitespace.
